description: React component for displaying a table of execution records with sorting, selection, and status icons.

methods.name: getIconFromStatus
methods.description: Returns the icon component based on the execution status state.

methods.name: getIconColor
methods.description: Returns the color string based on the execution status state.

methods.name: handleRequestSort
methods.description: Handles sorting request when user clicks on column headers.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles selection toggle for individual rows.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if a row is selected.
